data.text:
🚨 Traffic Advisory – Sri Vijaya Puram 🚨

In view of the ongoing protest by certain student unions and the proposed Andaman Bandh call on 16.02.2026, it is hereby informed that all roads and routes across Sri Vijaya Puram will remain open for normal vehicular movement.

Traffic personnel will be strategically deployed at key junctions and sensitive locations to ensure the smooth and uninterrupted flow of traffic.

Commuters are advised to remain calm, follow traffic regulations, and cooperate with on-duty personnel.

📞 For any traffic-related queries or assistance, please contact the Traffic Control Room at 03192-243812.
@AndamanPolice @Andaman_Admin @DGPANIslands @MediaRN_ANI
